prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your pet is coming to life on your desktop!", "Try pressing the hotkey or clicking the tray icon to command your pet anytime.", "Explore Pet Tricks"]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name your companion"]
2: ["Inspect Photo Quality", "Check that lighting is bright and your subject's face is centered for the best pet generation.", "Lighting Checked", "Looks Great! Proceed"]
3: ["Desktop Pet Tray & Shortcut Guide", "Look for the pet icon in your system tray to summon, hide, or change pet settings anytime.", "Got It!"]
4: ["Your adopted pets are saved to your account. Signing in restores all pet history automatically."]
5: ["Generating 3D desktop companion textures... This takes about 2-3 minutes."]
6: ["For best results, upload bright, well-lit photos with clear front visibility."]
7: ["Your Pet is Live! Here is How to Control It", "Use the system tray icon to summon or hide your pet, or right-click your pet on desktop to open quick actions."]
8: ["Safe Sign-In: All pets, accessory data, and settings are safely linked to your login."]
9: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Experience"]
